svg.title: alon-skills — Six Claude Code skills and a build loop, measured with and without the plugin
svg.desc: Dark command-center banner for alon-skills v3.2.2 and workflow-watch 0.4.1. Left: wordmark, pitch, and the six slash commands (/architect, /review-swarm, /ask-the-council, /prompt-generator, /up-to-date, and /ponytail vendored from DietrichGebert/ponytail MIT). Right: selected eval case per skill on Fable 5.1 with and without the plugin: review-swarm 1.00 vs 0.40, ponytail (vendored) 0.90 vs 0.50, ask-the-council 1.00 vs 0.33, architect 1.00 vs 0.67, up-to-date 0.88 vs 0.62. 19/19 evals passing at 0.7 threshold; 120 trigger prompts with 75 to 100% fire rate and 0 false fires.

g.text: Six Claude Code skills and a build loop,
measured with and without the plugin.
Plus workflow-watch, a live tracker in a side pane beside the chat.
Proactive by task shape · explicit "when not to use" boundaries · fresh subagent stages.
plan → scout → spec → build → measure → refute → fix → close
One selected case per skill · 0.7 threshold
review-swarm · N+1 query diff, ranked report
120 trigger prompts · 75–100% fire rate · 0 false fires
Claude Code CLI & VS Code extension · Tested on macOS and Windows
